svg.title: estack at a glance
svg.desc: estack gives every coding agent session the same rules and skills. Each repo adds its own facts. Every code change follows one line: restate, start, build (with tests first where cheap), prove, ship, deploy. Lessons go back into estack so every repo improves.
svg.text: ESTACK · RULES AND SKILLS FOR CODING AGENTS
1 plugin · 29 skills · 1 rules file · 3 files per repo
What every agent session starts with
Rules and skills from estack. Facts from your repo. No guessing.
Broken? core:incident · Infra? core:change · Risky diff? core:blast-radius
Each station is a skill the agent loads.
2. Notice: review, bot, incident, repeat fix
3. Route it to one home in estack
5. Push: every repo gets it next session
